intro: We invite you to dress in elevated, elegant attire with a relaxed island feel.
suggestions: The looks below are suggestions to inspire you. Any elegant style in our colours is welcome.

looks.label: Looks for the ladies
looks.heading: ladies
looks.lead: Opt for solid-coloured, monochromatic dresses in elegant styles.
looks.rest: Long, flowy dresses, draped silhouettes, slip dresses and sophisticated co-ord sets are welcome.

looks.heading: gentlemen
looks.rest: Wear a long-sleeve or short-sleeve dress shirt, a refined co-ord or a Chinese-collared top in our wedding colours.
